current.title: Round 73 DELIVERED — the task modes round (0.73.0)
current.detail: The posture tier of the owner's directive 'proper detailed system prompts which the agent accesses when required and on the basis of the task' — SKILLS = methodology (R61/R70/R72), MODES = posture (this round), REFERENCES = depth (R72-c); nothing auto-activates. (1) The modes core: NEW agents/modes.ts — six builtin postures plan/debug/build/review/explore/refactor (bodies 2,084-2,546 chars, iron laws, PAIRS WITH skill pairings) + custom modes from .acute/agents/*.md (frontmatter name/description/tools, ≤8 × 16K caps, 8 diagnostic kinds, custom shadows builtin, project-root trust); resolveEffectiveModes pure + sync. (2) The backend: prompt-registry 21→23 (task-modes index + active-mode deep body, both after skills, both .acute/prompts/-overridable, strictly ctx-gated — golden fixture byte-stable); computeModeHints (the R72-a shared scorer; computeTaskHints unchanged); sessions.active_mode + migration 0027 (the ALTER + the switch_mode allowlist append with the read_skill companion rule); PATCH /sessions/:id activeMode (null clears, unknown → 400 with available ids) + GET /projects/:id/modes metadata-only; NEW switch_mode tool (list / activate-returns-body-once / deactivate via sentinels none-off-auto + JSON null); prepareTurn threads modes — custom-mode tools narrow the allowlist (narrow-only, NO_TOOLS sentinel), a vanished custom mode is swept with a one-turn note; PLAN_MODE_TOOLS gains switch_mode (the D4 dark-tools honesty rule). (3) The frontend: the composer TaskModePicker + the /mode slash intercept (optimistic PATCH + rollback; word-boundary so /moderation falls through) + api.ts (Session.activeMode, TOOL_CATALOG switch_mode — the R45 drift guard repaired, fetchProjectModes, patchSessionActiveMode). (4) The system-reminder renderer (ONE fenced-reminder mechanism; dir-conventions migrated byte-identically — r72-dir-conventions 20/20 unmodified — plus the per-turn ReminderBudget) and skills 18→20 (spec-planning, performance — INSERT OR IGNORE). Verification: 2558 root tests in 138 files, all green (agent-core 1637/1637 in 74 files — +135; frontend 909/909 in 62 files; e2e 12 env-gated), lint/typecheck clean, license audit CLEAN (134 deps), a live HTTP smoke of the mode routes (GET /modes incl. a custom, PATCH set/bogus-400/null-clear). The live gates (the TASK MODES section + Task signal line on real messages, switch_mode activation riding the following turns, the picker + /mode slash, the two skills' triggers, custom-mode tool narrowings) await the owner's Windows field run. Next: the R74 queue — delegate_task task_id/background/resume (deferred from R73 by design), external plugin ctx enrichment (cline's appendContext seam), the lessons-ledger affordance as the reminder injector's third consumer, ratings-driven prompt tuning.
